newsitem.title: USA: NIPSCO unit files $300 million debt shelf.
newsitem.headline: NIPSCO unit files $300 million debt shelf.

text.p: NIPSCO Capital Markets Inc, a unit of NIPSCO Industries Inc filed Tuesday a shelf registration with Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $300 million in medium-term notes due nine months or more from date of issue.
The offering will be made through Goldman Sachs & Co., Merrill Lynch & Co and Morgan Stanley & Co Inc.

Capital will advance the net proceeds to the parent after completion of the offering. NIPSCO Industries will use most of the funds to repurchase common stock granted in connection with the pending acquisition of IWC Resources Corp.
The balance of the proceeds will be used for the repayment of indebtedness, and any remaining balance thereafter will be used for general corporate purposes.
Capital was organized by the parent to engage in financing activities that provide funds for use in the parent's business operations and those of its direct and indirect wholly-owned subsidiaries.
